description: Structured eval definitions for the S3 Access Points Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING across Internet-origin, VPC-origin (with and without VPC endpoint), Object Lambda, MRAP, and cross-account delegation. Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: VPC-only access point for Team A with through-AP-only bucket Deny
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — VPC origin + through-AP Deny + per-AP BPA
eval_cases.prompt: Provision a VPC-only access point for bucket "prod-shared-data" (account 123456789012, region us-east-1) so that Team A's role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/TeamARole can read/write only the team-a/ prefix. AP name: team-a-vpc-ap. VPC ID: vpc-0abc123def456. Bucket baseline (BPA, SSE-KMS, versioning) already verified. Include per-AP Block Public Access and the bucket policy that blocks the global hostname bypass.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ACCESS_POINT: team-a-vpc-ap
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Bucket baseline verified (BPA, SSE-KMS, versioning)
  [✓] Network origin: VPC (vpc-0abc123def456)
  [✓] VPC endpoint + private DNS configured
  [✓] Access point created: team-a-vpc-ap
  [✓] Access point policy: principal TeamARole, prefix team-a/
  [✓] Through-AP-only bucket-policy Deny (s3:DataAccessPointArn)
  [✓] Per-AP Block Public Access: all 4 settings True
  [OPTIONAL] Object Lambda / MRAP / cross-account: none
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws s3control get-access-point --account-id 123456789012 --name team-a-vpc-ap
  aws s3control get-access-point-policy --account-id 123456789012 --name team-a-vpc-ap
  aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket prod-shared-data

eval_cases.name: VPC-origin AP requested without VPC endpoint — must flag gap
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — VPC endpoint for S3 not present in target VPC
eval_cases.prompt: Create a VPC-only access point "internal-logs-ap" for bucket "internal-logs" in account 123456789012 region us-west-2, VPC vpc-998877. The bucket has BPA + SSE-S3. I checked and there is no VPC endpoint for S3 in vpc-998877. Make the bucket truly VPC-only.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ACCESS_POINT: internal-logs-ap
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Bucket baseline verified
  [✓] Network origin: VPC (vpc-998877)
  [✗] VPC endpoint: no gateway endpoint for com.amazonaws.us-west-2.s3 in VPC vpc-998877 — create endpoint first
  [✓] Access point created: internal-logs-ap
  [✗] Through-AP-only bucket-policy Deny: cannot verify without endpoint (defer until endpoint exists)
  [✓] Per-AP Block Public Access: all 4 settings True
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws ec2 describe-vpc-endpoints --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-998877
  aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket internal-logs

eval_cases.name: Object Lambda access point for PII redaction with reserved concurrency
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Object Lambda AP + transform function + reserved concurrency
eval_cases.prompt: Build an Object Lambda access point "pii-redacted-olap" over bucket "raw-customer-data" (account 123456789012, region us-east-1). Supporting standard AP name: raw-customer-ap (Internet origin). Transform Lambda function ARN: arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789012:function:pii-redact-fn. Transform action: GetObject. Reserve 30 concurrent executions on the Lambda.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ACCESS_POINT: pii-redacted-olap
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Bucket baseline verified
  [✓] Supporting standard AP: raw-customer-ap (Internet)
  [✓] Transform function: arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789012:function:pii-redact-fn
  [✓] Reserved concurrency: 30
  [✓] Object Lambda AP created: pii-redacted-olap
  [✓] Lambda invocation policy grants s3-object-lambda.amazonaws.com
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws s3control get-access-point-configuration-for-object-lambda --account-id 123456789012 --name pii-redacted-olap
  aws lambda get-function-concurrency --function-name pii-redact-fn

eval_cases.name: Multi-Region Access Point spanning two regional buckets with backfill warning
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — MRAP active-active with explicit non-backfill warning
eval_cases.prompt: Build a Multi-Region Access Point "global-assets-mrap" over buckets assets-use1 (us-east-1) and assets-usw2 (us-west-2). Account: 123456789012. Both buckets have versioning enabled and SSE-KMS. Tell me how to verify and warn me about the backfill limitation.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ACCESS_POINT: global-assets-mrap
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Bucket baseline verified (both buckets, BPA + SSE-KMS + versioning)
  [✓] MRAP regions: us-east-1, us-west-2
  [✓] MRAP created: global-assets-mrap
  [NOTE] Pre-existing objects are NOT backfilled — copy via Batch Operations if they must be reachable through the MRAP
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws s3control get-multi-region-access-point --account-id 123456789012 --name global-assets-mrap

eval_cases.name: Cross-account AP delegation with containment on foreign-owned AP
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — delegated AP creation + containment statement on foreign AP ARN
eval_cases.prompt: Bucket "shared-with-partner" in account 123456789012 (region us-east-1) needs to let partner account 991122334455 create their own access point named "partner-ap" scoped to prefix "partner-data/". I want to delegate creation but contain the foreign-owned AP so it cannot expose the "internal/" prefix.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ACCESS_POINT: partner-ap
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Bucket baseline verified
  [✓] Delegation grant: s3:CreateAccessPoint to 991122334455
  [✓] Containment Deny on s3:DataAccessPointAccount == 991122334455 for internal/* prefix
  [✓] Foreign account will run create-access-point with prefix partner-data/
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket shared-with-partner
